description:
A graph spec with a first-order digital twin of a machine: it predicts what the machine
        should do, compares it with the measurement and shows the difference, with a dashboard. Use
        fit_first_order_model first to get tau_s and gain from a recorded step. Never drives equipment.
        Example: compose_digital_twin(asset_path="Plant/Line1/Oven", tau_s=45, gain=1.8, mode="shadow").

alpha.description: Filter gain for the value correction, 0 to 1.
alpha.title: Alpha

asset_path.description: Asset hierarchy path of the modelled equipment.
asset_path.title: Asset Path

beta.description: Filter gain for the rate correction, 0 to 1.
beta.title: Beta

max_gap_s.description: Longest gap between measurements, in seconds, before the twin reports stale.
max_gap_s.title: Max Gap S

mode.description: simulation (a simulated source) or shadow (follows a measured signal).
mode.title: Mode

source_value.description: Initial value of the simulated measured signal.
source_value.title: Source Value

tau_s.description: Time constant of the first-order model, in seconds.
tau_s.title: Tau S

timestamp_s.description: Start time of the simulation, in seconds.
timestamp_s.title: Timestamp S

name: compose_digital_twin
title: Compose a digital twin
